note: City of Farmington park, 177 acres around a 44-acre no-wake lake, with a two-mile trail around the lake, a swim beach and cabins. The camping loop sits north of the lake behind a wooded slope. --Claude
summary: Rate found: $20-$30 + tax (city page). Count corrected 43 -> 35 RV sites (13 FHU, 14 W/E, 8 E); the page lists no tent sites. Reservations by phone but not required; coin showers Apr-Oct. Not waterfront confirmed (lake ~100 m off behind woods). Pin fine.
flags: SITES: stored count 43 included 8 tent sites ($10) from the old note; the city page lists only the 35 RV/camper sites (13 full hookup, 14 water/electric, 8 electric only) and mentions no tent sites, so count is 35.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront confirmed): the 44-acre lake is a lake, not a pond. On NAIP the camping loop sits along the park road at the edge of the crop field north of the lake; the shore is ~90-110 m south behind a continuous wooded slope. A few campers along the north-shore road to the west also have trees between them and the water. No open apron.
HOOKUPS: amperage is not stated on the city page; electric left unknown.
PIN fine: on the camping loop.
